title: I turned my GitHub contribution graph into a Bloomberg-style trading terminal
why_read: A fun, well-executed novelty visualization project turning GitHub contribution data into a stock-trading-style dashboard, more neat than practical.
analysis: This project is a GitHub Action that renders a user's contribution calendar as a finance-terminal-style chart with candlesticks, volume bars, and computed statistics like Sharpe ratio and max drawdown, all as a single dependency-free SVG. It's a creative data visualization hack with zero runtime dependencies, which is a nice engineering touch for something meant to run in CI as a README badge generator. The actual technical complexity is modest, mostly SVG generation and GitHub API data wrangling, making it a fun but lightweight curiosity rather than a deep technical read.
